about: Bromont is a city in the Eastern Townships (Estrie), Quebec, in the Appalachian foothills southeast of Montréal. A major ski resort, a technoparc industrial park, and equestrian and bike tourism define this mountain-town economy. About 11,000 people live in Bromont.
seoSummary: Eastern Townships mountain city southeast of Montréal—ski resort, technoparc, and equestrian tourism.
